sentences: Random quantum circuits produce states that may be difficult to learn from a limited supply of copies.
This question asks for an approximate cloning algorithm that makes additional useful copies without first reconstructing the circuit description.
The source explicitly considers even subexponential running time as a meaningful algorithmic target.
Learning-based approaches can perform poorly in the fidelity regime of interest, so a direct copying strategy could reveal a different computational mechanism.
Understanding that possibility would clarify the computational hardness assumptions used in cryptographic applications of hard-to-learn quantum states.
